column1: ## Round-2 held-out benchmark -- ratings (2026-10-02; re-rated 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-16).
## 109 inputs the engine had never been tuned against, rated on the criteria
## fixed in CRITERIA.md BEFORE the first input was run (the round-1 scale,
## unchanged). Provenance per input in manifest.tsv; method and analysis in
##   PASS     everything present AND correctly structured
##   PARTIAL  broadly right; something lost or mis-shaped
##   FAIL     the output misrepresents the input
## strategy/conf  the default-mode winner (--max-strategies 1, confidence rank)
## prio           the --rank priority winner; "=" means the same strategy, and
##                the output was byte-identical (cmp) in every such case
## rating         default mode; prio_rating is the priority-mode result
## multi          `provost --multi` relative to default: same / better / worse
## family         the shape family the write-up aggregates by
## cluster        the defect cluster ("-" for PASS)
## Columns input .. note are the 2026-10-02 rating, unchanged. The five
## columns after them are the 2026-10-14 re-rating
## on the engine after the fix round that worked patterns 1-4 (CHANGELOG
## 2026-10-14), default mode, same criteria and rules:
## strategy_1014/conf_1014  the default-mode winner on that engine
## cov_1014       its line coverage (%), the 4th field of --emit-meta
## rating_1014    default-mode rating; prio / multi were NOT re-rated
## note_1014      "=" when the default tidy output is byte-identical (cmp) to
##                2026-10-02, so the rating carries over; else what changed
## The last two columns are the 2026-10-16 regression check, on the engine
## after the fix round of that date (CHANGELOG, the three 2026-10-16 engine
## entries), default mode, same criteria and rules:
## rating_1016    default-mode rating; prio / multi were NOT re-rated
## note_1016      "=" when the default tidy output is byte-identical (cmp) to
##                the 2026-10-14 run, so rating_1014 carries over; else what
##                changed (winner, coverage and consistency are in the .meta
## Since 2026-10-14 this set has been looked at: it measures REGRESSION, not
## generalisation (see the postscript of the round-2 report).
## Self-assessment by an agent, as in round 1: a screen, not a verdict.
## The moment anyone tunes the engine against these files they stop measuring
## generalisation -- update the ratings in the same commit and say so here.
